dialogues.speaker: Warehouse Notice
dialogues.text: "...This cave is being used as a temporary warehouse. Please do not store any items here unless they are of great mercantile value!"

dialogues.speaker: Warehouse Notice
dialogues.text: "...Qiaoying Village has been busy trying to resolve its tea leaf problem lately. The number of villagers guarding the ruins has been greatly reduced. We can store the antiques we've been digging up here and transport them under the guise of being 'tea leaf products.'"

dialogues.speaker: Warehouse Notice
dialogues.text: "...Tusheng discovered a merchant with some Sumpter Beasts. Perhaps we could use them to transport our goods..."

dialogues.speaker: Warehouse Notice
dialogues.text: "...Important: Do not hit the big iron lump in the depths of the cave!"
